continue.description: Default true. false stops Claude entirely after the hook runs, and beats an event-specific decision. It does not by itself block a PreToolUse tool call.

stopReason.description: Shown to the user when continue is false. It stays in the conversation, so Claude sees it later.

systemMessage.description: A warning shown to the user, not added to Claude's context. Capped at 10,000 characters; longer text is saved to a file and replaced by its path and a 2,000 character preview.

terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

decision.description: Listed in the docs' summary table only; not confirmed by this event's own section.

reason.description: The reason, if decision is read at all.

additionalContext.description: Text added to Claude's context next to the error, wrapped in a system reminder and not shown as a chat message. State facts rather than give commands. Capped at 10,000 characters.

title: PostToolUseFailure hook output
description: Adds context for Claude after a failure. Exit code 2 shows stderr to Claude. The docs disagree on blocking: their summary table lists this event under top-level decision, while this event's own section offers only additionalContext, so decision is modelled as optional and should not be relied on.
